<x_0.4141><y_0.2945>EXPLANATION.<x_0.6875><y_0.3109><class_Section-header>

<x_0.1367><y_0.3086>" Let A—B be a fmooth board, 3 or 4 feet long,
1 inch thick, and 9 inches wide, with 5 figure ledges
glued thereon. each being half an inch afunder, half an
inch wide, and half an inch high ; which rifling ledges
reprefent our 5 lines of mutic, and their fpaces: and
the two outward lines, being made a little lower, may
ferve as leger lines, on occasion. The cyphers repre-
fent fo many holes bored into every line and fpace, half
an inch afunder ; wherein pegt of different hapes are
to be fet, to reprefent the feveral forts of notes and
characters of the tune : which pegs the blind perfon
may know by feeling, as well as he does his keys of
the organ or harpfichord: fo that, by keeping his fin-
gers on the 5 lines, he feels the feveral pegs as they
come on, and are fet to reprefent the feveral forts of
notes, on both line and fpace ; whilst his right hand
flrikes the respective key, &c. he first knowing the
names of all his keys, his lines, fpaces, and the mark
of every peg. Let each peg be about half an inch
high, when fet in very fall. [N. B. The blind per-
ton mult firlt be taught the names of the above lines
and fpaces in both the treble and bafs cliffs ; and that
he mult feel his treble with his right hand, and his
bafs with the left hand ; each being contrary, as you
may fee by the letters of the above table, A and B ;
and mult learn each part [eparate.]<x_0.9658><y_0.6711><class_Text>

<x_0.1426><y_0.6695>" Of pegs, he mult have a great number of every
fold, to fet his tune with, which he may mark as fol-
lows :<x_0.9639><y_0.7125><class_Text>

<x_0.1455><y_0.7172>For a _Senibreve_, 4 top-notches.<x_0.6191><y_0.7328><class_Text>

<x_0.2295><y_0.732>_Minim._ 2 top-notches.<x_0.5781><y_0.7469><class_Text>

<x_0.2285><y_0.7461>_Crotchet_, 1 top-notch.<x_0.5674><y_0.7602><class_Text>

<x_0.2305><y_0.7594>_Qaaver_, one corner cut off.<x_0.6533><y_0.7734><class_Text>

<x_0.2275><y_0.7742>_Semiquaver_, 2 corners cut off.<x_0.6885><y_0.7883><class_Text>

<x_0.2314><y_0.7875>_Demijemiquaver_, all 4 corners cut off.<x_0.7998><y_0.8023><class_Text>

<x_0.208><y_0.8016>_Refls._ a notch in the corner.<x_0.6396><y_0.8156><class_Text>

<x_0.209><y_0.8148>A _Plat_, 1 notch on the ride.<x_0.6562><y_0.8289><class_Text>

<x_0.2266><y_0.8281>_Sharp_, 2 notches on the fide.<x_0.6709><y_0.843><class_Text>

<x_0.2256><y_0.8422>_Point_, 3 notches on the fide.<x_0.667><y_0.857><class_Text>

<x_0.2246><y_0.8562>_Bar_, a flat thin top.<x_0.5488><y_0.8711><class_Text>

<x_0.2236><y_0.8703>_Repeat._ a tharp-pointed top, &c. &c. &c.<x_0.8564><y_0.8859><class_Text>

<x_0.1445><y_0.8891>But it is belt for every performer to make
and mark his own pegs; and deliver them one<x_0.959><y_0.9234><class_Text>
